about.paragraph1: Jabes Automotive is your trusted auto repair and towing partner on Long Island. We handle everything from scheduled maintenance to complex diagnostics and emergency roadside assistance — with fair pricing and no surprises.
about.paragraph2: We've built our name the old-fashioned way: doing good work and treating people right. Word-of-mouth drives this shop, because we explain what we find, give honest estimates, and stand behind every repair.

serviceArea.description: Based at 45 Remington Blvd, Ronkonkoma — in-shop for repair and diagnostics, on the road for towing anywhere across Suffolk County.

footer.tagline: Honest auto repair and towing, built on trust — proudly serving Suffolk County from Ronkonkoma to the Hamptons.
